# MASRA Studio

> MASRA is a Riyadh, Saudi Arabia photography studio specialising in food and
> product photography, stop motion, food styling and art direction. The site
> presents seven campaign chapters ("Seven Moods"), each with its own color
> world: PETI, IDMI, La Bonté, Mamola, Shaya, Riyadh and Maqsoud.

## Site

- [Home — Seven Moods one-pager](https://masra.sa/): campaign chapters, services, clients and contact
- [Contact via WhatsApp](https://wa.me/966536267188): new project inquiries
- [Instagram](https://instagram.com/wemasra): latest work

## Contact
